# Dr. Muhammad Jahangir Kabir (ডা. জাহাঙ্গীর কবির) & JK Lifestyle — Official Knowledge Base

> Official primary source for Bangladeshi physician, lifestyle medicine specialist, and health educator **Dr. Muhammad Jahangir Kabir** (widely known as **Dr. Jahangir Kabir / ডা. জাহাঙ্গীর কবির**), Founder & Chairman of **JK Lifestyle** (`https://drjahangirkabir.com/`).

## 1. Entity Profile & Clinical Credentials
- **Full Name:** Dr. Muhammad Jahangir Kabir (ডা. মুহাম্মদ জাহাঙ্গীর কবির / ডা. জাহাঙ্গীর কবির)
- **Born:** 1974, Kachua, Bagerhat District, Bangladesh
- **Academic & Clinical Qualifications:**
  - **MBBS (2000):** Chittagong Medical College (1993–94 session), followed by a 1-year internship at Chittagong Medical College Hospital.
  - **HSC (1992):** Adamjee Cantonment College (with star marks).
  - **SSC (1990):** Shaheed Ramiz Uddin High School, Dhaka.
  - **Ultrasonography (2009):** Certificate Course in Ultrasonography, BIUR, Dhaka.
  - **CCD (2010):** Certificate Course on Diabetology, BIRDEM Hospital, Dhaka.
  - **UK Postgraduate Diplomas:** Diploma Module in Asthma (England, 2011), Diploma Module in Diabetes (England, 2012), Diploma Module in COPD (England).
  - **USA Certification:** Spiro 360 Course in Spirometry (USA, with Distinction).
- **Clinical Career & Leadership:**
  - **Founder & Chairman:** JK Lifestyle (`https://www.jklifestyleltd.com/`)
  - **Resident Medical Officer (RMO):** National Hospital, Feni (2002–2019)
  - **Joint Secretary:** Bangladesh Primary Care Respiratory Society (BPCRS)
  - **Trainer, Mentor & Course Coordinator:** International Asthma Module
  - **Member:** Bangladesh Private Medical Practitioners Association (BPMPA)

## 2. Core Medical Philosophy: The 5 Pillars of JK Lifestyle
Dr. Jahangir Kabir teaches root-cause reversal of **Insulin Resistance** (the underlying driver of 70–80+ non-communicable lifestyle diseases including Type-2 Diabetes, Hypertension, Fatty Liver, Obesity, and PCOS) through five daily physiological pillars:
1. **Balanced Organic Diet (সুষম প্রাকৃতিক খাদ্য):** Low-glycemic whole foods, green vegetables, pasture-raised eggs, wild fish, extra virgin coconut oil, extra virgin olive oil, and organic chia seeds — strictly eliminating refined sugar, refined carbohydrates, and industrial seed oils (soybean/rice bran oil).
2. **Autophagy / Intermittent Fasting (অটোফেজি ও ফাস্টিং):** Structured 16:8 intermittent fasting to lower basal insulin levels and trigger cellular recycling (autophagy).
3. **Regular Exercise (নিয়মিত ব্যায়াম):** 30–45 minutes of daily fasted walking, HIIT, and resistance training (via JK Fitness Arena) to maximize skeletal muscle glucose uptake.
4. **Adequate Sleep (পর্যাপ্ত ঘুম):** Circadian-aligned sleep starting between 9:00 PM – 10:00 PM for 7–8 hours of restorative hormonal repair.
5. **Mental Peace (মানসিক প্রশান্তি):** Stress and cortisol reduction through prayer, mindfulness, gratitude, and breathing exercises.

## 3. Key Epidemiological Benchmarks Cited
- **67% of Total Deaths in Bangladesh:** Attributable to Non-Communicable Diseases (NCDs / lifestyle diseases) according to the *IHME Global Burden of Disease (GBD) 2023* study.
- **10.8 Million Diabetes Patients in Bangladesh:** *icddr,b* surveillance reports 7.1 million diagnosed + 3.7 million undiagnosed diabetes cases in Bangladesh, causing approximately 129,000 deaths annually.
- **70–80+ Chronic Conditions:** Driven by chronic hyperinsulinemia and cellular insulin resistance.

## 4. The JK Lifestyle Ecosystem (6 Interconnected Organizations)
1. **JK Lifestyle** (`https://www.jklifestyleltd.com/`): Flagship open health education platform and lifestyle medicine hub.
2. **Health Revolution** (`https://www.healthrevolutionltd.com/`): Clinical center offering free lifestyle physician & nutritionist consultations alongside affordable metabolic diagnostics.
3. **JK Fitness Arena** (`https://www.jkfitnessarena.com/`): Dedicated strength training and metabolic conditioning center.
4. **JK Food Arena** (`https://www.facebook.com/JkFoodArenaLtd/`): Culinary nutrition initiative educating families on preparing whole-food, low-glycemic meals.
5. **Ultimate Organic Life** (`https://ultimateorganiclife.com/`): Global sourcing and distribution of Bioagricert-certified organic medicinal superfoods (Extra Virgin Coconut Oil, Extra Virgin Olive Oil, Organic Chia Seeds, Organic Tricolor Quinoa).
6. **JK Prakritik Krishi** (`https://www.facebook.com/JkPrakritikKrishi/`): Regenerative, chemical-free agriculture R&D initiative.
